visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The scene opens in a brightly lit indoor kitchen. A young man with short black hair is wearing a black shirt. He is holding a yellow banana to his ear like a headset and moving his hands over a laptop and a small colorful spinning disco light as if he is a professional DJ. Bright, colorful light patterns are projected onto him and the white kitchen cabinets. (2) The camera cuts to a close-up of a young girl with short black hair sitting at a dining table. She looks at the camera with a neutral, almost confused facial expression while holding a small toy. (3) Cut to a young boy in a yellow sweater also looking confused and blinking. In the background, a woman is visible holding a phone to record. (4) The scene shifts back to the man who is now pointing toward a family sitting at a dining table. An older man and a woman are seen dancing and waving their hands in the air. The lighting remains vibrant with disco effects. (5) A close-up shot focuses on a tiled floor covered in brown spills and food scraps. A purple microfiber mop head enters the frame and quickly wipes the floor clean in a circular motion. (6) The man appears again, now wearing a gold chain over his black shirt, holding a large red and yellow box for the brand 'Supamop'. He gestures enthusiastically towards the camera while explaining the product features, standing in the same kitchen environment.

It highlights the mess created by a family 'party' to demonstrate the mop's efficiency and ends with a promotional giveaway campaign.
